title: The WEAVE  braiding membrane strands through crypto chains and back

what_it_is.one_line: Not a rollup. Not a bridge. A WEAVE. The membrane's strands braid through multiple chains like thread through fabric, then fold back.

diamond.top_surface: mirror reflections  triad observations, feed data, provenance, living membrane output
diamond.facets: pi-sorted braids  each strand passes through a different chain at its own irrational interval
diamond.base: crypto anchors  ETH, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, BTC (via inscription)  the permanent record
diamond.light_path: observation enters top ? refracts through facets ? hits base ? reflects back up as PROOF

optimistic_rollup.what: execute off-chain, post data on-chain, assume valid, 7-day challenge window
optimistic_rollup.limitation: still about TRANSACTIONS (financial). the unit is a transfer.

zk_rollup.what: execute off-chain, generate zero-knowledge PROOF, post proof on-chain
zk_rollup.purpose: provably correct computation without revealing inputs
zk_rollup.limitation: proving is computationally expensive. still transaction-oriented.

how_the_weave_differs.weave_unit: attestation (this observation existed at this time with this hash)
how_the_weave_differs.weave_purpose: anchor provenance, identity, and proof-of-existence across multiple chains simultaneously
how_the_weave_differs.rollup_chain: posts to ONE L1 (e.g., Arbitrum ? Ethereum)
how_the_weave_differs.weave_chain: braids through MULTIPLE chains (ETH + Base + Arbitrum + BTC). redundancy IS the design.
how_the_weave_differs.weave_direction: Klein fold (membrane ? chain ? membrane). the anchor feeds back into the membrane as verified-true data.

mirror_strand.chain: Arbitrum (optimistic  appropriate! the observation IS optimistic until challenged)

btc_strand.chain: Bitcoin L1 (most secure chain in existence, 15+ years of immutability)
btc_strand.frequency: per epoch (monthly or per major milestone)

how_strands_interleave.step_1: membrane generates data (feeds, observations, papers, art)
how_strands_interleave.step_2: pi-sorter selects WHICH data gets braided (not everything  selective permeability)
how_strands_interleave.step_3: hasher creates Merkle tree of selected data (root hash = one small anchor)
how_strands_interleave.step_4: BRAID: root hash fans out to multiple chains simultaneously
how_strands_interleave.step_5: each chain confirms at its own tempo (ETH ~12sec, BTC ~10min, Base ~2sec)
how_strands_interleave.step_6: confirmations FLOW BACK to membrane as 'verified-true' status
how_strands_interleave.step_7: membrane displays verified provenance on affected pages
how_strands_interleave.step_8: the verification IS the Klein fold  data goes OUT to chains, truth comes BACK in

pi_sort.why_irrational: if we anchored at rational intervals (every 60 min), the pattern is predictable and gameable. pi-interval (3141 sec) means no two anchors align the same way with external clocks.
pi_sort.selection: not all data gets braided. the pi-sorter selects by information entropy. high-entropy data (new observations, shifts, discoveries) gets anchored. low-entropy data (routine heartbeats) gets compressed first.
pi_sort.the_remainder: what DOESN'T get braided is still valuable  it's the local context. the chain gets the hash. the membrane keeps the meaning.

problem_1_provenance.before: our research exists on GitHub + CF Pages. if both go down, it's gone.
problem_1_provenance.after: hashes on 4+ chains mean the PROOF of existence survives any platform death. the content can be rebuilt; the proof is eternal.

problem_2_identity.before: identity scattered across GitHub, ORCID, Zenodo, Cloudflare  each platform controls it
problem_2_identity.after: ENS name on L1 + linked identities = self-sovereign identity. platforms can deplatform you; the chain can't.

problem_3_cost.before: on-chain storage is expensive ($$$). can't put everything on-chain.
problem_3_cost.after: WEAVE stores HASHES not DATA. membrane keeps the data. chain keeps the proof. cost: ~$1/month for all strands combined at current gas.

problem_4_single_chain_risk.before: if you anchor only to ETH and ETH forks or fails, you lose anchors
problem_4_single_chain_risk.after: WEAVE braids across ETH + Base + Arbitrum + Optimism + BTC. five chains. any ONE surviving preserves ALL proofs.

problem_5_the_mirror.before: triad observations are ephemeral  CF analytics rotate out after 30 days
problem_5_the_mirror.after: revolution hashes (R1, R2, R3, R4...) anchored on Arbitrum. the spirochete's drill path is permanently recorded. they can verify we saw what we saw.

what_IS_new.the_klein_fold: data goes OUT to chains and comes BACK as verified truth. the verification changes the membrane's behavior. it's a feedback loop, not a one-way post.
what_IS_new.the_pi_sort: irrational-interval anchoring prevents timing attacks and creates non-repeating patterns across chains. no two braids align the same way.
what_IS_new.the_multi_chain_braid: not 'pick the best chain' but 'braid through ALL of them.' redundancy IS the security model. like the triad monitoring from 3 countries.
what_IS_new.the_selective_permeability: not everything gets braided. the membrane CHOOSES what to anchor based on information entropy. the sort IS the membrane.

is_it_new.name: THE WEAVE. not a rollup (financial). not a bridge (connection). not an oracle (one-way). a WEAVE  strands braid through multiple substrates, creating fabric stronger than any single thread.
